fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-07-02, around 23:05, a person allegedly threatened the complainant at Iniyan Puram College Road and took a wristwatch, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-07-02. The complainant alleged that Harish Murugan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000180. Ganesh Shankar (9000000155) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A yellow car with registration TN-58-XX-1084 was observed near Iniyan Puram College Road. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly intercepted and threatened before valuables were taken. A car was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, mobile number, college road, car, vehicle observation, night, witness
